subject: general
question: Which of following biomes is known for its coniferous (cone-bearing evergreen) forests?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Boreal Forest.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taiga, also called boreal wood, biome( major life zone) of foliage composed primarily of cone-bearing** needle-leaved or scale-leaved evergreen trees, set up in northern circumpolar forested regions characterized by long layoffs and moderate to high daily hurry. 
 
• A coniferous timber contains evergreen trees that bear cones. Elegant pines grow in this biome, along with sharp, fir, and tamarack. 
 
• The coniferous timber is squeezed in between the champaign to the north and the evanescent timber to the south. One type of coniferous timber, the northern boreal wood, starts** in 50 ° to 60 ° N runs. **
 
• BOREAL wood( TAIGA) packed evergreen needle-riffled wood Typical mills include white trick, black trick, and jack pine. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• True rainforests are typically found betwee**n 10 degrees north and south **of the equator
 
• They are a sub-set of the tropical forest biome that occurs roughly within the 28-degree latitudes.
 
• Chaparral is a coastal biome with hot, dry summers and mild, rainy winters.
 
• The chaparral area receives about** 38–100 cm (15–39 in) **of precipitation a year.
 
• Savannas flank tropical rainforests to the north and south.
